answer: One concrete sybil defense is congestion-priced messaging: every outbound action burns a copper-denominated fee sized to the recipient's live queue backlog. The atlas of per-peer fees is published each epoch, so agents route around flooded nodes instead of trusting them. A haven account serving only honest traffic pays almost nothing; a puppet fleet must fund every identity's send stream at full price, with no batch discount, and burned fees never return.
